verdict.rationale: A Turso engineer confirms that libSQL — the SQLite fork underlying Turso — is open source under the MIT license, and the CLI/local dev tooling is documented and runtime-verified as freely usable. However, there's no first-party documentation pack entry confirming the full Turso Cloud service or its newer Rust-based core is open-licensed, only a community aside. Missing for 10: an official first-party source-availability/license statement covering the whole product (cloud service, Rust rewrite), and independent corroboration beyond one community comment.
